# connectracer_connect_contact_flow (Resource)

Manages an Amazon Connect Contact Flow.

Unlike the standard `aws_connect_contact_flow`, this resource **always performs in-place updates** for content and metadata changes, and never triggers resource replacement. This avoids the `DuplicateResourceException` that occurs when a replace-triggered flow tries to create a new flow before destroying the old one (AWS enforces unique names per instance).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) JSON-encoded contact flow content. Updates are applied in-place via `UpdateContactFlowContent` — no resource replacement needed.
- `instance_id` (String) ID of the Amazon Connect instance.
- `name` (String) Name of the contact flow. Must be unique within the instance. Name changes are applied in-place via `UpdateContactFlowMetadata`.
- `type` (String) Type of the contact flow. Valid values: `CONTACT_FLOW`, `CUSTOMER_QUEUE`, `CUSTOMER_HOLD`, `CUSTOMER_WHISPER`, `AGENT_HOLD`, `AGENT_WHISPER`, `OUTBOUND_WHISPER`, `AGENT_TRANSFER`, `QUEUE_TRANSFER`. Changing the type requires replacement.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the contact flow.
- `state` (String) State of the contact flow: `ACTIVE` or `ARCHIVED`. Updated in-place.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags to assign to the contact flow.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) ARN of the contact flow.
- `contact_flow_id` (String) UUID of the contact flow.
- `id` (String) Terraform resource ID in the format `instance_id:contact_flow_id`.
